methods.label: Find the time for the whole job
methods.explanation:
From \(8\!:\!30\) am to \(11\!:\!10\) am is \(2\) hours \(40\) minutes, or \(160\) minutes. At the machine's steady rate, this is one third of the total working time. Therefore the whole job takes
\[
160\div\frac13=480\text{ minutes}=8\text{ hours}.
\]
Eight hours after \(8\!:\!30\) am is \(\boxed{4\!:\!30\text{ pm}}\), choice \(\text{D}\).
